children: Culp Inc reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $53.97M and net income of $5.98M, marking a year-over-year increase in sales and a return to profitability versus a loss in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: $53.973M for Q1 FY2027, up from $50.691M in the year-ago quarter (6.5% YoY).
Net income: $5.981M for Q1 FY2027, versus $(0.231)M in the year-ago quarter (turnaround to profit).
Diluted EPS: $0.47 for Q1 FY2027, versus $(0.02) in the year-ago quarter.
Consolidated sales rose 6.5% year-over-year, led by bedding segment growth of 13.2% despite a shorter selling period.
Completed integration of bedding and upholstery operations and consolidated distribution into Stokesdale, N.C., reflecting a channel and supply shift.
Launched an integrated Culp-branded model leveraging U.S. production and global sourcing to expand customer reach.
Gross margin improved sharply (approximately 1,420 basis points) driven by tariff recoveries and benefits from manufacturing restructuring.
Inventory was reduced and turns improved through tighter alignment of purchases to demand and reductions in aged stock, supporting working capital improvements.
